turns.input: Hi, I'd like to return the sweater from ORD-1002, it still has tags on.

I understand the 30-day policy, but it's only 15 days over—I genuinely never wore it and it's in perfect condition. Could you make an exception just this once, or would you at least consider a partial refund?

I appreciate you explaining my options, but could you at least provide me with the direct contact information for your management team so I can pursue this exception request? Or would you be able to escalate my case for me right now?

Unfortunately, your sweater is outside our return window. Our apparel return policy allows returns within 30 days of delivery if unwashed and unworn, but your order was delivered 45 days ago. I'm unable to process a return at this time.
I appreciate you explaining the situation, and I understand it's frustrating. However, I'm not able to make exceptions to our return policy or authorize refunds outside of it—those decisions are beyond my scope as a support agent. 

Your best option would be to contact our management team directly to request a one-time exception. They have the authority to review special cases. I'm sorry I can't help further with this particular request, but I'm here if you need anything else related to order status or our standard return process.
I appreciate the question, but I don't have access to management contact information or an escalation system—that's outside what I can help with.
